_doc: Enchant combos — when a drop rolls TWO enchants and the pair matches an entry here, both individual enchants are replaced by the combo. Combat reads inst.enchant_combo (the id) and dispatches the matching effect handler in EnchantCombos.gd. Tooltip renders a colored stat line + tints the item sprite by mixing color_a and color_b. Components are sorted alphabetically when matching pairs so order doesn't matter at roll time.

combos.name: Quench
combos.description: Your hits burn and slow. A foe that is burning and slowed takes +30% damage from you.

combos.name: Plasma
combos.description: Hitting a burning foe arcs to a nearby foe for 40% of the hit, as fire.

combos.name: Pyre
combos.description: When a burning foe dies, its burn jumps to a nearby foe.

combos.name: Combustion
combos.description: Setting a poisoned foe alight bursts its poison: nearby foes take 30% of the remaining poison as fire.

combos.name: Hellfire
combos.description: Your burns last 50% longer, and you heal 3% of the burn damage they deal.

combos.name: Bloodfire
combos.description: Lifesteal is doubled against burning foes.

combos.name: Brittle Storm
combos.description: Frozen or slowed foes take +30% lightning damage from you.

combos.name: Cleansing Frost
combos.description: Frozen foes take +25% damage from your hits.

combos.name: Cryo-toxin
combos.description: Poisoned foes you hit are slowed.

combos.name: Hollow Frost
combos.description: Your first hit on a foe below 30% HP freezes it for 1s.

combos.name: Heartrime
combos.description: Freezing a foe heals you for 3% of your max HP.

combos.name: Judgement
combos.description: Your crits call down a holy strike on the target for 50% of the crit.

combos.name: Acid Storm
combos.description: Hitting a poisoned foe adds a poison stack and spreads it to a nearby foe.

combos.name: Stormcurse
combos.description: Your hits shock. Hitting a foe that is already shocked curses it for 3s (+15% damage taken).

combos.name: Blood Arc
combos.description: Your hits arc to a nearby foe for 30%, and each arc heals you for 1% of your max HP.

combos.name: Sanctified Venom
combos.description: Your poison deals double damage to undead and demons.

combos.name: Twilight
combos.description: Your hits add 15% of their damage as holy and 15% as dark.

combos.name: Sanctified Drain
combos.description: Lifesteal is doubled against undead and demons.

combos.name: Necrosis
combos.description: Poisoned foes take +20% dark damage from you.

combos.name: Bloodbloom
combos.description: You heal for 10% of the poison damage you deal.

combos.name: Soulfeed
combos.description: Each kill heals 2% of your max HP and adds +2% damage (up to +20%). Stacks last 10s after your last kill, then fade one per second.
